'''2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals Alan Sagan Hoth North Ridge Regional LS Winner''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alan Sagan]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals]]. The post is titled 'Hoth North Ridge Regional LS Winner' (posted 24 August 2000); Alan Sagan won the 2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals on 5 August 2000. The post itself gives no record.<ref name="dt-9815">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9815 Hoth North Ridge Regional LS Winner], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 24 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9815/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9815/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018131026/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9815/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Hoth North Ridge Regional LS Winner'''
* '''Author:''' Alan "Serpent" Sagan
* '''Published:''' August 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' An Old school profit.  I had no idea what to play for Light, so I played this.

=== Strategy ===

This is an old school deck, is very solid.	Everyone's seen this type of deck and played against or with it.  Do i really need to go into strategy?

Alright fine.

Free Han early or late, depending on the situation.  I usually go early, but the reason i picked Premiere Han even they I free him right away is because it gives me the option of waiting if I want, plus I like his text.

vs BHBM, don't deploy Luke until you see vader, then deploy luke AWAY from vader, or if you're winning battles, just give him luke. cause force loss.  Depends on the situation.

How well this deck does is based alot on the skill of the player. It's a soldid deck that will do well against anything.
